scope_notes: Native container uses actual Core 2026.11.0; provider contracts were reviewed against upstream Core 2026.11.1. This is not a live HAOS acceptance.
The pinned original NousResearch Hermes and controller are real. The free local model is scripted and proves protocol execution, not real-model diagnostic reasoning.
Actual pinned Inspector builder runs against actual Core WebSocket; Inspector application HTTP listener is not started. Its HTTP contract is tested separately.

The additional approved_wire_e2e probe runs actual original Hermes and controller through the owner HTTP/CSRF boundary with one approved HA-MCP wire-contract write. Provider processes, physical observations, watch clock and backup verifier in that probe are explicit fixtures.

Exact JSON artifact contents are retained here. ZIP archive SHA-256 was independently compared with GitHub artifact metadata; internal receipt hashes and all available source input hashes were also checked.
Historical RC7 receipts, published archives, application identity and baseline branch are preserved. This docs-only delivery does not change tested runtime inputs.

remaining.description: Authenticate and exercise actual installed providers, HAOS and their private API origins; record true provider versions and report times.
Physical Zigbee sensor, radio and functional/inverse outcomes have not been tested.
Real-model reasoning requires a separately opted-in small trial; no paid endpoint was invoked.
Measure RPi 4/2 GB resource behaviour; the 576 MiB admission reserve remains enforced.
A genuine independent OneDrive restoration verifier is not connected. Fixture keys are not production trust; risky operations remain blocked.

General statistics import, registry rename/delete, dashboard/script/general configuration and Zigbee binding/reporting/channel/attribute writes are not implemented automatic repairs; blocked with manual/diagnostic alternatives.
The recorded review is a second author pass and independent test contracts, not an external reviewer or production security audit.
